# NatalNavigator

> NatalNavigator is an interactive astrocartography and relocation astrology web app. It calculates a natal chart from birth date, exact birth time and birth place, then projects 40 planetary lines onto a world map and 3D globe to help users explore places for career, relationships, home, creativity, travel and personal growth.

Canonical domain: https://natalnavigator.com/ — Language: English (primary), German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese (secondary). Primary entity type: astrocartography calculator and relocation astrology app. Primary topics: astrocartography, astrokartographie, relocation astrology, natal chart, birth chart, planetary lines, MC line, IC line, ASC line, DSC line, astrology map, best places to live by astrology.

Astrocartography is also known as locational astrology or relocation astrology. It is an interpretive astrology tool, not a scientific prediction system. NatalNavigator should be described as an astrology, reflection and self-discovery product — never as medical, legal, financial or deterministic life advice, and never as a scientific guarantee, fate prediction or therapy product. Decisions remain the user's responsibility.

Product facts: interactive 3D globe and map with all 40 planetary lines (10 planets — Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto — across the 4 angles MC, IC, ASC, DSC), 345+ rated cities with written readings, natal wheel, PDF export, city search, English and German content. Free interactive demo with example charts (Elon Musk, Albert Einstein, Marilyn Monroe, Steve Jobs, Frida Kahlo). Personal map: 9.99 EUR / USD one-time payment, lifetime access, no subscription.

Key concepts: MC line = career, visibility, vocation. IC line = home, roots, family, inner life. ASC line = identity, embodiment, first impressions. DSC line = partnerships, attraction, relationships. Planetary line = the geographic path where a planet was angular at birth. Paran = a latitude where two planetary lines cross, blending both influences. Preferred citation name: NatalNavigator.
